source_title: Polar vs Lemon Squeezy vs Gumroad
snippet_primary: "To avoid holding off my release, I switched to Gumroad so I could start selling right away. Gumroad worked well. It was easy to set up, and I liked the clean interface. But the fees felt a bit high. So once my Lemon Squeezy store was approved, I moved everything back over."
subject_exact: Seller-reported temporary Gumroad use due to ease of setup, with subsequent migration to Lemon Squeezy due to fee perception
parser_notes: 'Fees felt a bit high' is subjective — no specific figure given. Lemon Squeezy named as destination. 'Start selling right away' contrasts with Lemon Squeezy approval requirement. March 2026.
